name: TÖLVA

meaning.en: Icelandic for computer, from tala (number) and völva (seeress): the oracle in the machine.
meaning.nb: Islandsk for datamaskin, av tala (tall) og völva (volve, spåkone): orakelet i maskinen.

meaningSource: Wiktionary, entry tölva: coined by Sigurður Nordal in 1965 from tala and völva.

tagline.en: Learn Icelandic from the oracle in the machine.
tagline.nb: Lær islandsk av orakelet i maskinen.

meaning.en: tala means both speech and number.
meaning.nb: tala betyr både tale og tall.
